name: Solitaire
description: Classic seven-column patience in a panel, to play while Claude works. It pauses when a Claude tab of the window finishes and waits for you. Reads only the window's tab statuses; never types into a session.
author: Oleg Bronzov

fourColour.title: Four-colour deck
fourColour.description: Diamonds blue and clubs green, so each suit has its own colour as well as its own symbol.
